title: Enforce photo-management capability for photo duplication
scope: Fix the account capability middleware in server/routes.ts so only session duplication selects session_create and photo duplication selects photo_management. Preserve session access, edit and lock checks. Add HTTP middleware regression coverage for all four combinations of session_create and photo_management, checking denial payloads and that denied requests cannot reach mutation handlers. No new features or unrelated authorization changes.
why: Backend authorization needs executable HTTP regression tests and compiler checks; the fast tier does not run route tests.
coverage: docs/validation/manifest.json test-standard includes typecheck and unit-tests; npm run test:unit executes server/__tests__/routes.test.ts.

approval.reference: Assigned task 1010 in the active conversation
approval.direction: Fix the photo duplication authorization bypass without introducing features
approval.applicability: Narrow server middleware repair and regression coverage within the assigned scope

assertions.check: With session_create true and photo_management false, POST photo duplication returns 403 capability_denied for photo_management without running its mutation handler; all four capability combinations follow photo_management only.
POST session creation and duplication remain governed by session_create only across all four capability combinations, independently of photo_management.

regression.rationale: Repairs a server-side authorization bypass permitting unauthorized photo writes.
regression.covers: Approved users with edit access and session creation enabled must not bypass a disabled photo-management capability by calling photo duplication.
regression.testLocation: server/__tests__/routes.test.ts — account capability route guard, duplication capability matrix
regression.assertion: Real HTTP requests through the production middleware return exact 403 photo_management denials before mutation handlers run; permitted photo duplication and session operations follow their own capabilities across all four combinations.
